notes.title: Serial Cleaner EASIER TO CLEAN update is live NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello dear players!

Couple of days ago we've announced that a new, free update for Serial Cleaner is coming really soon, exclusively on Steam. And today is the day! You can already enjoy new gameplay mode in Serial Cleaner, which we call EASIER TO CLEAN!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26356876/e132675df0e1847387ebc40848b375c1ff2974f3.gif

What is EASIER TO CLEAN all about? From now on, Normal Mode will be easier to clean! All you have to do is start the game as you normally would to feel the benefits of reduced detection rates, a slower speed for Police and quieter movement. For those still wanting to break a sweat with a harder experience, go to the Options menu where you can enable Hardcore mode.

We hope that you'll explore a lot of exciting gameplay options with this entirely new and diverse way to play Serial Cleaner. 

As always we wait for your feedback, comments, user-generated content (and you've already proven that you can make amazing pieces of art :D) We're here for you, ready to answer every question. Please share your ideas for the further development of Serial Cleaner!

All the best to you,
Jacek @ iFun4all

notes.title: Serial Cleaner Super Update coming November 29th
notes.notes:
Dear players, how are you? :)

It is my great pleasure to announce a great new addition to Serial Cleaner, available November 29th EXCLUSIVELY on Steam!

This addition is a fresh, completely free game mode, which we like to call "EASIER TO CLEAN MODE" 

Although the name of the update pretty much speaks for itself, it's obviously changing the gameplay, making it faster, more arcadish and, well, easier.

Serial Cleaner is a challenging game, and every level needs a lot of careful planning. Even the tiniest mistake makes you start over, and we have received a lot of feedback from players asking us to prepare a game mode more suitable for players who prefer a more casual gameplay. And the EASIER TO CLEAN MODE is our response :)

The new mode will allow you to run fast, pass every level easier than ever before and focus on pace and pure action! 

The EASIER TO CLEAN MODE will be released as a free update November 29th. And we already can't wait to listen to your feedback!

We hope you'll find the EASIER TO CLEAN MODE of Serial Cleaner as satisfying as we do! Enjoy the game and, as always, we encourage you to spread the word about Serial Cleaner, provide further feedback and ask us questions!

All the best to you :)

Jacek @ iFun4all

notes.title: Serial Cleaner release date is on the way!
notes.notes:
Hi gals and guys, how are you? :)

It's been quite a while since we last wrote. The reason for the long silence was that we were finalizing the global publishing deal for Serial Cleaner and today we can officialy announce that Curve Digital is co-funding the development process, as well as helping us deliver the best version of Serial Cleaner we can dream of!

Initially we wanted to launch Serial Cleaner pretty early this year, but with the help of Curve we have more time to add a lot of new features, thanks to which Serial Cleaner will be bigger, better, much more diverse, challenging and, hopefully, fun to play for you guys!

For the next few months we won't be updating the game's client, no worries though, for we work really hard on delivering an awesome piece of software, I promise! 

Together with Curve we aim at the Summer launch, simultanously on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. Those of you, who trusted us and decided to buy our game in the Early Access stage will of course get a full version of Serial Cleaner, without any additional cost, on the day of release. 

You can sure that you'll receive so much more rich content! The level of Cleaner's replayability will grow significantly, for you can expect a lot of brand new features, which we really enjoy working on. 

Therefore, milestone after milestone, map after map and mode after mode, we're getting closer to delivering a seriously BIG game, characterized with unique, hand-drawn graphics, arcade-stealth mechanics, memorable, original soundtrack that will be fun to listen to even outside the game, as well as tons of great features, which will leave you wondering about how to spend the next couple of hours in Serial Cleaner. And I'm telling - there will be a lot to choose from!

Thank you so much for your support and feedback, for without you and your trust we'd never be able to find such a great partner as Curve. It's your positive reviews and your dedication to our everyday work made that happen. In return, we promise we'll do everything we can to deliver one of the best, most eye-catching and immersive indie games of 2017!

Currently we're preparing for the GDC/GC in San Francisco, for Serial Cleaner is nominated to the Best Console/PC Hardcore Game Award. And that is already a great success that belongs to the whole Serial Cleaner community!

Thanks again! Please, be just a little more patient, you won't regret it! :)

Best,
Jacek @iFun4all

PS. I encourage you to check the new trailer and read a few words from Kris, our designer and writer, on Playstation blog: https://blog.eu.playstation.com/2017/02/22/destroy-active-crime-scene-evidence-this-summer-in-ps4-stealth-game-serial-cleaner/

notes.title: Serial Cleaner version 0.6 live!
notes.notes:
We deliver new levels, game mode, enemy types, Real-World Data functionalities and new music tracks that will melt your soul!

iFun4All S.A., a game development studio from Krakow, Poland, is super pleased to inform that Serial Cleaner, currently available in the Early Access on Steam and in Humble Store, has been updated to the version 0.6!

Serial Cleaner has entered Early Access on the 29th of September 2016. For the last two months we've been listening carefully to our fans' feedback. 

The latest update delivers all that our players dreamed of! Here's a short list of new functionalities and changes:

three new levels, even more complex and tougher than the ones you know!

two new enemy types! Play levels 13-15 to see the Scout and Dispatcher in action!

new Hard Mode variant: going to Options and ticking the Hard Mode option will make it impossible to hide when being pursued by enemies! It’s super tough this way, but some of you requested it, so try it out… just don’t say we didn’t warn you!

new Real World Data functionality on select stages. Levels 1-4, 8, and 11-12 will change depending on the time of day. Play them before and after sunset to see the difference and experience the different setups!

cleaning blood is now bound to the Left Shift Key on keyboards and the Right Trigger on gamepads. You won't clean blood automatically, instead, you can choose when to break out the hoover and clean away. See how you like this change and let us know!

we also included a keyboard control scheme geared towards left-handed players. To change your bindings, go to Options and pick one of the two presets. We're trying to figure out the best control scheme, so please give us your feedback!

new music! Listen to five new tracks, and hear final versions of several of the previous songs!

bug fixes and optimization all around


Thank you for your continous support! Please stay sharp for another updates and information :)

Of course, as always, we're waiting for YOUR feedback!

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us!

Best,
Jacek @iFun4all

notes.title: What was available in the version 0.4?
notes.notes:
iFun4All's game Serial Cleaner, currently available in the Early Access version on Steam and Humble Store for Windows, OSX and Linux is now bigger, better and even more  enjoyable! We have introduced new levels, features, music tracks, fixed some bugs and improved enemy AI!

Full list of features, available in the version 0.4 of Serial Cleaner:


4 new amazing, but also super challenging levels that you'll love playing over and over again!

3 new music tracks to better feel the great atmosphere of the 70s

A TIMER! complete a level to have your time displayed in the main menu! Serial Cleaner is now more addictive than ever before

Some pre-final sounds for the new levels, work in progress

Improved enemy AI - police officers behave less chaotic, are smarter and much better aware of their surroundings - you'll struggle to escape them!

New GUI

New difficulty curve - Level 2 and 4 have been slightly nerfed, so there's a smaller diffivulty gap at the very beginning of you Serial Cleaner's career

New way to show player's progress on the map

Various bug fixes
  

We do hope that you'll enjoy Serial Cleaner. Of course we'd love to get as much feedback from you as possible!

Thanks for your support!

Best,
Jacek @iFun4All

notes.title: What was available in the version 0.2?
notes.notes:
Here’s the list of the features in the first Early Access build of Serial Cleaner:

- 7 stages
- 4 enemy types
- Picking bodies and disposing of them
- Picking up evidence
- Hiding
- Moving objects
- Sound objects
- Shortcuts
- Cleaning blood
- A level of randomization on levels with each restart
- Pre-final sound design (some tweaks still needed)
- Music is subject to change and rearrangement
- Keyboard and Gamepad controls
- Menu options include: Resolution, Windowed Mode, music and sound volume

No Tutorial yet, for that please refer to the “Controls and Mechanics” topic over HERE http://steamcommunity.com/games/522210/announcements/detail/941640769125019417.

There will be a properly developed story for the game, but for now you can find snippets of it in the level descriptions in the Menu.
